meta.scope: Source-audited planning atlas; no game or spine edits.
meta.artist_evidence: Descriptions and search URLs supplied by the user; not independently verified art history.
meta.placement_scope: Exact registry key in layers.interactables in current active-spine map_data.json files. No direct token does not exclude generated, nested, branch or dynamic placement.
meta.readiness_scope: Capability gates use the declared ladder, whose nodes currently have proposed status. They do not prove a finished tutorial, student competence or artifact runtime health.

hinge.title: Articulate joined planes
hinge.operation: Nested plate transforms, bounded hinge angles and XR hinge/handle wiring.
hinge.limit: An articulated construction with a fixed root. The hinge-and-return companion now tests desktop dragging and release. No physical XR trial, gravity settling or plate-collision rejection is established.
hinge.probe: Change one hinge limit; release a plate and check which poses remain reachable.
hinge.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

bend.title: Bend a surface without changing its connections
bend.proposed_home: Primitives mesh → Transformation; return in Form Finding
bend.operation: Fixed triangle connectivity; vertex positions rotate in a cascade with an authored sine billow.
bend.limit: The inspected fold wall is a set of built stages. Its drape is a formula, not cloth settling under force.
bend.probe: Hold vertices and faces fixed; vary fold amount and compare the silhouette and passage.
bend.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

cloth.title: Hang and settle a connected sheet
cloth.operation: Spring-grid cloth, pinned points, gravity, wind and hanging SoftBody strips.
cloth.limit: Different solvers and collision models. Self-contact, tearing and material accuracy require separate checks.
cloth.probe: Move one pin or change stiffness; compare the settled shape with the same gravity.
cloth.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

soft.title: Let a body deform or retain a settled form
soft.operation: Deformation with pressure/strain readouts; a vessel built by a finite settling pass.
soft.limit: A bounding-box volume proxy is not enclosed volume. A frozen settled mesh is not a continuously live body.
soft.probe: Keep the mesh and loading fixed; compare pressure feedback on and off.
soft.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

repeat.title: Repeat an element and expose a small deviation
repeat.operation: Fixed indexed frame sites with repeatable deviations; a separate low-contrast procedural line grid.
repeat.limit: A resemblance to a grid does not establish the historical work’s actual score or material procedure.
repeat.probe: Hold every address fixed; change one offset or the line contrast.
repeat.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

suspend.title: Keep addresses while fragments change
suspend.operation: 75 generated fragments at retained positions, with vertical rods and a variation control.
suspend.limit: A verified standalone geometry study; no fracture history, dynamic suspension or installed spine placement.
suspend.probe: Change the fragments and verify that every centre stays put.
suspend.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

assemble.title: Pick up parts and compose an arrangement
assemble.operation: XR-pickable primitive offcuts and an assembly table that claims and snaps resting fragments.
assemble.limit: Parts are generated offcuts, not an arbitrary archive importer or automatic Boolean union.
assemble.probe: Place the same seven pieces twice; change only one placement constraint.
assemble.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

network.title: Grow or reconnect a spatial graph
network.operation: Seeded node positions, branching and optional lateral reconnections drawn as branches.
network.limit: Drawn edges do not provide tensile mechanics, knots, provenance or navigable clearance by themselves.
network.probe: Keep the nodes; remove lateral links and compare connected routes.
network.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

void.title: Use one void to make a room and a positive
void.operation: One interior definition feeds CSG subtraction and intersection, with collision enabled.
void.limit: A digital positive from a shared volume; physical casting, demolition and the history of a dwelling are not simulated.
void.probe: Move one opening and check that both the room and positive retain its trace.
void.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

reflection.title: Return the actual viewer through a surface
reflection.proposed_home: Colour for appearance; Shaders for the rendering apparatus
reflection.operation: The wardrobe mirror uses a reflected camera and off-axis frustum in a shared-world viewport.
reflection.limit: The generic mirror prop only assigns a metallic material. The working planar camera does not supply curved or recursive mirrors, or stereo-per-eye XR reflections.
reflection.probe: Move the actual camera sideways and check reflected parallax before multiplying mirrors.
reflection.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

planes.title: Make overlap and passage through coloured planes
planes.operation: The planes layout separates coloured sheets, routes and work positions; filter/opaque comparison retains geometry.
planes.limit: Layered alpha tint, not spectral transmission or an optically accurate two-way mirror.
planes.probe: Take one sideways step, then switch opacity without moving the partitions.
planes.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

light.title: Build a room around changing illumination
light.operation: A white chamber with a central changing light; connected apertures with luminous rims, lights and a ramp.
light.limit: Rendered illumination and open geometry, not a measured psychophysical Ganzfeld or a volumetric mist model.
light.probe: Hold surface colour fixed while changing the source; compare at two eye heights.
light.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

trace.title: Retain the movement of a specific input
trace.operation: Headset or labelled desktop-camera samples retained as a spatial path and floor projection.
trace.limit: Head/camera position includes locomotion. It is not foot tracking, mocap, biometric sensing or evidence of lived experience.
trace.probe: Repeat a walk; distinguish measured position, projection and the gaps in sampling.
trace.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

passage.title: Make a dimension into a condition of passage
passage.operation: A variable opening tested against a fixed capsule; scaling an authored furnished room.
passage.limit: One chosen collider is not a universal body. An opening-width test cannot stand in for a real social border.
passage.probe: Keep the visitor collider fixed; find the smallest opening it can cross.
passage.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

body.title: Assemble a synthetic body and change its pose
body.proposed_home: Primitives as parts → Shaders / Queer Rubber
body.operation: A six-arm, three-head primitive construction with an unfolding parameter; a separate actual-player wardrobe.
body.limit: The plural body is a geometric pose, not a rigged avatar, face scan, soft-body solver or authored choreography.
body.probe: Keep the parts; alter their attachment or pose and identify what must become jointed.
body.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

surface.title: Let a rule move across surfaces
surface.operation: Shared pattern coordinates across room and flowers; a procedural RGB-triad/banding display.
surface.limit: A generated glitch image is not actual codec corruption; a surface effect need not change collision.
surface.probe: Freeze geometry; move the shared pattern and follow one boundary between objects.
surface.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

agents.title: Let local state continue to change a world
agents.proposed_home: Swarm Intelligence; broader ecology in Procedural Generation
agents.operation: Predator/prey/food updates and local flocking rules, with authored configuration and population controls.
agents.limit: Simplified agent rules and sometimes a stabilising restock policy; not an open-ended trained-agent world.
agents.probe: Hold the seed; disable one stabiliser or local rule and compare population history.
agents.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

learning.title: Distinguish a learning diagram from a trained model
learning.operation: Spatial network and GAN-role diagrams are present; their construction and animated metrics can be inspected.
learning.limit: The inspected GAN code advances illustrative losses with time and trains no model. A dataset-to-generative-image pipeline is not established by these artifacts.
learning.probe: Demand a real input, saved weights, a computed loss and a held-out output before calling it training.
learning.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

signals.title: Put a retained record or live view on displays
signals.proposed_home: Arrays → Randomness; monitor rendering is borrowed
signals.operation: A verified whole-room binary-array study; a separate multi-camera viewport monitor system.
signals.limit: The signal room contains a synthetic balanced inventory, not Ikeda’s encoded source data. Neither is a video editor or a biometric input device.
signals.probe: Keep the inventory, change neighbours, then state which display pixels came from which source.
signals.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

inscribe.title: Make a mark or a text field persist
inscribe.operation: A paint surface with explicit world-to-UV mapping and spray marks; a scrolling text viewport.
inscribe.limit: A visible mark is not an authenticated archive, and a scrolling string is not a spatial narrative editor.
inscribe.probe: Retain one mark; move the surface or viewer and check what coordinate system owns it.
inscribe.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

sound.title: Play a spatial sound and inspect a captured signal
sound.operation: SoundBox requests a stream from SoundBank and plays it through AudioStreamPlayer3D. The timeline separately captures the Master bus and draws a retained sample buffer.
sound.limit: SoundBox needs the SoundBank autoload and a valid collection. The timeline playback flag only advances its display: no captured-audio replay is wired. Its function named FFT averages time-domain samples, not spectral bins. Recording provenance and testimony are additional work.
sound.probe: Trigger a known SoundBank sound and compare its spatial playback with captured samples; implement and verify replay before describing the timeline as a recorder.
sound.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

power.title: Expose an authored rule of seeing or refusal
power.proposed_home: Critical returns; main placement must follow verified hosts
power.operation: An asymmetrical tower/cell arrangement with changing cone emphasis; a refusal record display.
power.limit: The inspected cones are visual apparatus, not proof of actual surveillance detection. A staged rule does not recreate labour, violence, ownership or collective politics.
power.probe: Name the actual rule, the person or object it acts on, and the evidence the apparatus records.
power.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

terrain.title: Turn a sampled field into a surface
terrain.operation: Seeded noise is sampled as mesh height with a terrain-collision construction path.
terrain.limit: Generated topography is not a surveyed site or a landscape’s social/ecological history.
terrain.probe: Change one field parameter while retaining the seed and compare visible height with support.
terrain.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

gravity.title: Make a force assumption visible
gravity.operation: Particles accelerate along an authored surface gradient; cloth has explicit gravity and constraints.
gravity.limit: The well is a force analogy, not general relativity. Buoyancy, tensile architecture and a traversable slide need their own mechanics and tests.
gravity.probe: Hold initial state; vary one force and record both motion and its retained path.
gravity.gate_basis: Declared capability requirements and their transitive prerequisites. This is a proposed making gate, not a runtime or learner certification.

base.label: A place to run
base.learn: Open, edit, run and stop a supplied scene.
base.make: Change a greeting in the prepared room.
base.transfer: Change a different property and find the result.
base.borrow: Camera, floor, light and editor setup.

xr.label: A body and a hand
xr.learn: Use a prepared XR player and controller pickup route.
xr.make: A scene in which a supplied object can be held.
xr.transfer: Take another prepared object in the same scene.
xr.borrow: XR Tools, controller bindings and Quest deployment; portable starter pending.

loop.label: Begin once, continue
loop.learn: Initialise, retain a value and update it.
loop.make: A greeting and a changing count.
loop.transfer: Change the increment without changing the display machinery.

point.label: Give a position a body
point.learn: Separate a position, its visible surface, collision and illumination.
point.make: A point whose appearance and physical boundary can differ.
point.transfer: Change the sphere radius while keeping the boundary, or the reverse.
point.borrow: Sphere construction; supplied light and switch. Coordinate reading and pickup follow in their own hall.

coordinates.label: Hold a point, name its reference
coordinates.learn: Use the supplied pickup; read and set X, Y and Z; distinguish local and world positions.
coordinates.make: Two independently positioned markers, ready to become endpoints.
coordinates.transfer: Move one marker in a translated parent; explain why the world address changes.
coordinates.borrow: Production XR pickable, guides and cards. Portable XR starter is still pending.

line.label: Connect and measure
line.learn: Relate two positions in one reference frame; measure separation.
line.make: A segment that follows two movable endpoints.
line.transfer: Connect two different objects and preserve its measurement.
line.borrow: Prepared A/B markers, segment.gd cylinder renderer and readout. XR hold remains supplied by the museum.

trace.label: Keep movement
trace.learn: Introduce an ordered list and a condition for retaining a sample.
trace.make: A path made from selected positions.
trace.transfer: Record a different moving point and compare what is lost.

grid.label: Choose an address
grid.learn: Separate a measured position from a snapped address.
grid.make: A retained path and a snapped comparison.
grid.transfer: Change spacing while preserving the original trace.

face.label: Close edges, give a face
face.learn: Close three edges between non-collinear points, then add a face and read its vertex order. Snapping and the carried trace return as further comparisons, not requirements for the first face.
face.make: An editable triangular surface with a visible boundary.
face.transfer: Move a corner; compare a collapsed triangle with a filled one.
face.borrow: Mesh display; the first face needs neither a grid nor the six-corner fan experiment.

enclosure.label: Let faces enclose a region
enclosure.learn: Join triangular faces into an open corner; add the missing base to close a tetrahedral surface. Separate enclosure from collision and entry.
enclosure.make: An open and a closed surface using the same four non-coplanar positions.
enclosure.transfer: Remove a different face; compare the visible opening with the supplied convex collision hull.
enclosure.borrow: Preview, face renderer and collision comparison. A single triangle was already a mesh.

mesh.label: Keep connections, move a corner
mesh.learn: Keep the triangle indices while changing vertex positions; locate the shared diagonal inside a square-looking cube face.
mesh.make: A cube whose corner can move while its face connections remain.
mesh.transfer: Change a different corner and predict which faces follow; compare with a rigidly folding net.
mesh.borrow: Prepared cube indices and the face renderer already used for the enclosure.

instances.label: Reuse a made object
instances.learn: Distinguish a mesh resource, a reusable scene and its placed instances. Arrange familiar parts without rebuilding them.
instances.make: An arrangement of two instances of a supplied box scene.
instances.transfer: Move one instance while keeping the other in place; then compare changing a shared resource.
instances.borrow: Box scene, material and pickup component; explain whether edited resources are shared.

primitive.label: Inspect the prepared form
primitive.learn: Configure a generated mesh; distinguish a fixed polyhedron from a polygonal approximation of a curved surface.
primitive.make: A configurable sphere, capsule or ring.
primitive.transfer: Hold size constant while changing its construction density.

refinement.label: Choose where to stop
refinement.learn: Follow a subdivision rule and compare a finite approximation with a mathematical limit. A tolerance and the last displayed example have different meanings.
refinement.make: A polygon comparison with a chosen side count and perimeter gap.
refinement.transfer: Choose a positive tolerance; find a member that meets it without claiming exact equality.
refinement.borrow: Circle reference, display and subdivision helper; numerical error analysis can wait.

geometry_return.label: What geometry promises
geometry_return.learn: Recognise familiar operations in an authored arrangement.
geometry_return.make: An arrangement whose geometry can be questioned.
geometry_return.transfer: Change one relation while preserving a recognisable reference.

transform.label: Give a form a changing pose
transform.learn: Translate a familiar object; distinguish assignment, interpolation and carrying.
transform.make: A moving object with a chosen start and destination.
transform.transfer: Move another object along the same route with different timing.
transform.borrow: Pickup base, player transport and safe reset.

rotation.label: Turn around a reference
rotation.learn: Choose a pivot and axis; compare orientation and swept space.
rotation.make: A rotating form with an observable return.
rotation.transfer: Move the pivot while keeping the angular change.
rotation.borrow: Quaternion and collision machinery until required.

scale.label: Scale meets a body
scale.learn: Change size relative to a reference and a receiving body.
scale.make: A size comparison that changes possible passage.
scale.transfer: Change the receiver instead of repeating the same enlargement.
scale.borrow: Player scaling infrastructure and safe reset.

threshold.label: A changing boundary
threshold.learn: Combine transforms, proximity and timing; distinguish restoration from memory.
threshold.make: A boundary that changes what can pass.
threshold.transfer: Give the same transform a different trigger or return rule.

array.label: Keep many addresses
array.learn: Introduce indexing and loops explicitly; distinguish an address from its occupant.
array.make: A row, plane and volume of independently addressable instances.
array.transfer: Remove an occupant without moving the other addresses.

tile.label: A local rule covers a surface
tile.learn: Map a small motif by index; change a rule and one exception separately.
tile.make: A small tile study and a larger receiving surface.
tile.transfer: Move the same rule from floor to wall.

clock_pattern.label: Give a pattern time
clock_pattern.learn: Separate stored pattern, step index and playback clock.
clock_pattern.make: A monochrome floor with a repeatable temporal pattern.
clock_pattern.transfer: Change timing without changing the stored pattern.

colour.label: Add an attribute
colour.learn: Attach colour to existing construction without changing its geometry.
colour.make: An arrangement whose parts carry chosen colours.
colour.transfer: Keep poses fixed while regrouping by colour.

light.label: A colour between things
light.learn: Distinguish surface colour, illumination and appearance.
light.make: A white receiver under a changeable light.
light.transfer: Change the receiver while keeping the light.

colour_space.label: Navigate a colour choice
colour_space.learn: Map a gesture or address to channels; distinguish RGB from HSV.
colour_space.make: A palette that selects and recalls a colour.
colour_space.transfer: Give the same input range a different channel mapping.
colour_space.borrow: Hand receiver and prepared palette display.

inscription.label: Leave colour somewhere
inscription.learn: Separate input, surface contact, persistent mark and visual access.
inscription.make: A supplied painting surface that retains a chosen mark.
inscription.transfer: Change the receiving surface and ask what can still be reached.
inscription.borrow: Spray, texture storage and transparency implementation.

pattern.label: Author a source, repeat it
pattern.learn: Separate source motif, palette, index rule and output surface.
pattern.make: A pattern made from an authored motif.
pattern.transfer: Change only the source, then only its repetition rule.

symmetry.label: Transform the repetition
symmetry.learn: Compose translations, reflections and glides; follow an address across a repeat.
symmetry.make: A controlled comparison of pattern families.
symmetry.transfer: Retain the motif while changing the symmetry rule.
symmetry.borrow: Symmetry catalogue, ribbon mesh and viewing controls.

rate.label: Compare change, accumulate
rate.learn: Define an independent variable, difference quotient and finite accumulation.
rate.make: A small slope and accumulated-area study.
rate.transfer: Change the sampling interval and compare its effect.

field.label: A rule at every position
field.learn: Read a vector-valued rule at a position and define how a receiver uses it.
field.make: A path following samples of a field.
field.transfer: Feed the same field to another receiving rule.

vector.label: Combine contributions
vector.learn: Add and subtract displacements; introduce projection when needed.
vector.make: An endpoint composed from named contributions.
vector.transfer: Translate the construction without changing its vector relation.

motion.label: Let state carry motion
motion.learn: Separate position, velocity and acceleration; identify the time step.
motion.make: A moving body whose previous velocity matters.
motion.transfer: Apply equal commands to bodies with different stored velocities.
motion.borrow: Physics engine or a clearly identified integration helper.

force.label: A law and its receiver
force.learn: Relate force, restoring response, drag, mass and support to a particular receiver.
force.make: A small force study with a held reference condition.
force.transfer: Apply one field to two differently configured bodies.
force.borrow: Collision solver, contact and support instruments.

descent.label: Follow a criterion
descent.learn: Define a cost, estimate a slope and choose a step.
descent.make: A descent that can reach different local endings.
descent.transfer: Keep the cost while changing the start or step size.
descent.borrow: Landscape display; derivative helper only if explained.

constraint.label: Let relations hold a form
constraint.learn: Introduce anchors, rest lengths and iterative relaxation.
constraint.make: A hanging or relaxed form whose boundary can be edited.
constraint.transfer: Move an anchor instead of specifying the final shape.

search_cost.label: Permit another ending
search_cost.learn: Compare greedy descent with an explicitly supplied random proposal.
search_cost.make: A search whose acceptance rule can be changed.
search_cost.transfer: Keep the proposal stream while changing the criterion.
search_cost.borrow: Seeded proposals before the full Randomness lesson.

oscillation.label: A phase gives a return
oscillation.learn: Relate a phase and amplitude to position; compare prescribed motion and dynamics.
oscillation.make: A repeated movement and its recorded projection.
oscillation.transfer: Change phase independently of amplitude or rate.

wave.label: Send and combine a wave
wave.learn: Use position and time in a wave rule; add contributions or modulate a parameter.
wave.make: A wave field or displaced column.
wave.transfer: Use the same values for a different receiver.
wave.borrow: Surface construction and audio buffer when needed.

sound.label: An event gives sound a beginning
sound.learn: Separate sampled signal, trigger, envelope and captured silence.
sound.make: A prepared voice with controllable onset and duration.
sound.transfer: Trigger the same voice twice and compare independent state.
sound.borrow: Audio device, buffers and microphone permissions.

synthesis.label: Many components, one result
synthesis.learn: Sum known components while keeping their amounts and shared phase.
synthesis.transfer: Remove one component and locate its consequence.

random.label: Keep a procedure, vary a draw
random.learn: Introduce seed, sample and eligibility; use a draw in an existing operation.
random.make: A repeatable random arrangement or walk.
random.transfer: Keep the draws while changing how they are interpreted.

distribution.label: A sample has an account
distribution.learn: Distinguish distribution, sample, boundary and record; follow a draw into a consequence.
distribution.make: A sampled population and its histogram or path.
distribution.transfer: Change the admissible set without changing the sampling method.
distribution.borrow: Histogram, trail display and game receiver.

noise.label: Sample a related field
noise.learn: Distinguish independent draws from spatially related samples; scale the input domain.
noise.make: A field mapped to height or colour.
noise.transfer: Feed the same sample values into another mapping.
noise.borrow: Noise algorithm implementation and mesh receiver.

field_body.label: A field becomes support
field_body.learn: Separate a scalar value, a threshold, a visible surface and a collider.
field_body.make: A terrain comparison with explicit support.
field_body.transfer: Keep the field while changing height or passage threshold.
field_body.borrow: Terrain meshing and safe walking support.

shader.label: A rule for a surface sample
shader.learn: Introduce shader input coordinates and output colour before complex effects.
shader.make: A small material with a controllable pattern.
shader.transfer: Apply the same rule to a second mesh.

shader_body.label: Displace, layer, remember
shader_body.learn: Distinguish vertex displacement, layered fields and persistent texture state.
shader_body.make: A material study whose visible and physical boundaries can differ.
shader_body.transfer: Keep geometry fixed while changing the shading rule.
shader_body.borrow: Collision remains separate; reaction-diffusion feedback supplied before CA.

cell.label: A local rule remembers
cell.learn: Introduce neighbours, discrete state and separate current/next buffers.
cell.make: A small grid that steps one generation at a time.
cell.transfer: Change one neighbourhood rule and inspect the global pattern.
cell.borrow: Display and neighbour-boundary policy made explicit.

cell_field.label: Change what a state can be
cell_field.learn: Extend binary state to graded values; compare inputs and paired histories.
cell_field.make: A local update with a readable difference between two runs.
cell_field.transfer: Keep the initial state while changing one coupling.

recursion.label: Replace a part with a rule
recursion.learn: Introduce a terminating recursive step and a depth budget.
recursion.make: A bounded recursively constructed curve or volume.
recursion.transfer: Keep endpoints while replacing what lies between them.
recursion.borrow: Mesh batching and safe geometry budget.

grammar.label: Rewrite, then interpret
grammar.learn: Separate a symbol sequence from its geometric reading; introduce a state stack.
grammar.make: A rewritten sentence read by a moving point.
grammar.transfer: Read the same sentence with another angle or interpretation.

grammar_space.label: A rule becomes a place
grammar_space.learn: Carry a grammar into width, support, competition and face operations.
grammar_space.transfer: Preserve the rule while changing which faces or resources qualify.

selection.label: Build, score, choose
selection.learn: Separate a genome, its constructed body and the criterion that selects it.
selection.make: A small population with inspectable selection.
selection.transfer: Use another score on the same candidates.

growth.label: A connection needs room
growth.learn: Choose a local growth/connection rule; distinguish connectivity from bodily clearance.
growth.make: A growing network and a carved route.
growth.transfer: Change eligibility or width while keeping the initial points.
growth.borrow: Neighbour search and carving/meshing; graph vocabulary returns later.

soft.label: Keep a body in relation
soft.learn: Vary pins, pressure and constitutive settings independently of presentation.
soft.make: A supplied deformable body with an authored boundary condition.
soft.transfer: Change an attachment rather than its visible form.
soft.borrow: Soft-body solver, stable mesh and collision setup.

reaction.label: Two fields change each other
reaction.learn: Separate local reaction, diffusion, update step and display.
reaction.make: A small two-field update with controllable coupling.
reaction.transfer: Hold the start and change one response term.
reaction.borrow: Field storage and surface extraction where used.

iso.label: Extract a boundary
iso.learn: Sample a scalar field; choose a level; interpolate crossings before assembling faces.
iso.make: A small sampled volume with an inspectable surface.
iso.transfer: Change threshold without changing the source field.
iso.borrow: Marching-cubes case table and mesh plumbing.

implicit.label: Compose the condition
implicit.learn: Edit contributions and domains; distinguish a height map from a volume.
implicit.make: A cavity, terrain or joined field surface.
implicit.transfer: Keep the extractor and replace the field.

boolean.label: Make room by subtraction
boolean.learn: Define union, intersection and ordered difference of solids.
boolean.make: A cavity or room whose operands can be repositioned.
boolean.transfer: Swap operand order, then scale the resulting negative space.
boolean.borrow: CSG engine; does not require implementing marching cubes.

agent.label: A local view of others
agent.learn: Give an agent state, a sensing neighbourhood and an update policy.
agent.make: A small group responding to neighbours or a shared trail.
agent.transfer: Change perception while keeping the response rule.

collective_search.label: Remember and compare routes
collective_search.learn: Separate personal memory, shared signal and optimisation criterion.
collective_search.make: A route or position search with inspectable memory.
collective_search.transfer: Keep the candidates while changing who can share a result.
collective_search.borrow: Graph storage before its formal chapter.

learning.label: Choose what improvement means
learning.learn: Define data, features, labels and an objective; distinguish clustering from classification.
learning.make: A small classifier or optimiser with a visible criterion.
learning.transfer: Change labels or the cost while preserving the observations.

network.label: Compose a learned mapping
network.learn: Use a supplied layer, then inspect one weighted sum, bias and activation.
network.make: A small mapping with editable weights.
network.transfer: Compare a single unit with a layered response.
network.borrow: Network first as a supplied component; single-unit inspection follows.

learned_memory.label: A mapping retains or generates
learned_memory.learn: Distinguish hidden state, generated sample and learned parameters.
learned_memory.make: A prepared model whose state or input can be changed separately.
learned_memory.borrow: Trained models and training machinery; not a one-chapter GAN implementation.

graph.label: Name the relations
graph.learn: Separate node identity, edge relation and drawing position.
graph.make: An explicit graph with an independent layout.
graph.transfer: Move the drawing without changing the adjacency.
graph.borrow: Layout solver; returns to earlier networks.

path.label: Choose a route or allocation
path.learn: Introduce queues/stacks when used; compare reachability, cost, capacity and matching.
path.make: A small path or allocation experiment.
path.transfer: Keep the graph and change the question asked of it.
path.borrow: Algorithm implementations beyond the first taught traversal.

assumption.label: A model has conditions
assumption.learn: Identify a geometric assumption and a changed interpretation.
assumption.transfer: Hold an observation while changing the model's premise.
assumption.borrow: Geometry renderers; no theorem proved by the display.

limit.label: A claim and its warrant
limit.learn: Distinguish construction, consistency, proof, projection and toy demonstration.
limit.make: A small explicit rule system with declared limits.
limit.transfer: Find a claim the demonstration cannot establish.
limit.borrow: Formal results require their own arguments; no forced coding quota.

proxy.label: Read what a measure measures
proxy.learn: Give each project term a stated operational measure and scope.
proxy.make: A comparison of order, variation and response under declared rules.
proxy.transfer: Replace one proxy while keeping the physical arrangement.
proxy.borrow: QFEP as the project's research framing; entropy and spread are not interchangeable.

coupling.label: Connect an intervention
coupling.learn: Distinguish a control value, a connection and the receiver's used value.
coupling.make: An intervention that can be connected, cut and compared.
coupling.transfer: Cut a route without assuming its previous effect is undone.
coupling.borrow: Receiver models and UI; verify each coupling.

situation.label: Keep the source with the judgement
situation.learn: Retain provenance, competing requirements and contributors rather than only a verdict.
situation.make: An arrangement that exposes who or what its rule admits.
situation.transfer: Change a rule while keeping the excluded case visible.

assembly.label: Make a work answer back
assembly.learn: Combine routes, assemblies and records into a situated work.
assembly.make: A first independent work built from selected earlier capabilities.
assembly.transfer: Name one promise, test it bodily, and revise the responsible operation.
assembly.borrow: Only the infrastructure the chosen work needs.
